strategy_version: V1 / DD Only / Combined DD+Vol (complete dynamic overlay replay)
dataset: exp_004 strategy_timeseries (3 raw alpha); exp_005 risk engine; exp_007 shipped returns

parameters.method_A: dynamic replay (exposure recomputed from simulated states)
parameters.method_B: direct block-bootstrap of shipped risk-controlled gross returns

assumptions: Shared-index block bootstrap of 3 raw alpha streams preserves cross-strategy dependence; all exposure layers recomputed per simulated path with 1-day lag (no look-ahead); comparison on gross returns (MDD cost-insensitive).
hypothesis: Does a complete dynamic overlay replay (A) change the drawdown picture vs resampling already risk-controlled returns (B)?
limitations: (1) V1 reconstructs to 1e-16 on the clean common base, but shipped DD Only/Combined were built on an imperfectly-recovered base (extra-lag artifact: base_ret=pr/exp.shift(1) while pr=port_pre*exp), so their clean-base dynamic CAGR is ~3-5pp below the shipped series; the shipped exp_007 series are NOT altered. (2) Net cost not simulated (name-level book turnover unavailable); comparison is gross. (3) Tail-MDD is block-length sensitive.

extra.status: dynamic replay complete for all three incl V1 dual-layer; no candidate selected
extra.finding: Direct resample (B) overstates worst-tail MDD vs faithful dynamic replay (A); overlay cannot de-risk when frozen into resampled returns.
